# FlexibilityThreshold

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The critical balance point between order and flexibility that must be tuned for a system to exhibit true complexity rather than being merely ordered or chaotic. Informs iNEST parameter tuning (e.g., synaptic plasticity, routing thresholds) to achieve optimal adaptive computation in dynamic network environments.
